completeness_caveat: This scorecard reports deterministic structural counts and a scripted semantic-entailment contract over a frozen, developer-authored benchmark whose labels await external review. A passing scripted set is NOT proof of real-world correctness; the actual model's semantic accuracy is not measured here, and this evaluation is neither perfect nor complete. Every finding requires human credit-analyst review.

conclusion_integration_accuracy.note: Deterministic conclusion-integration trace only (admitted <-> traced). It does not assess narrative quality; every statement requires human review.

corporate_structure_accuracy.note: Deterministic structural counts only; does not assess analytical or narrative quality.

management_analytical_quality.evaluation_kind: deterministic contract plus scripted expected judgments

numerical_verification_quality.note: Deterministic surface/token + canonical checks only. Absence of support is recorded as UNSUPPORTED (unverified), never as CONTRADICTED (rejected); causal/legal claims are routed to human review. This is not a measure of real-model semantic accuracy.

analytical_consistency.note: Repeated standalone runs over identical evidence are byte-stable (see run determinism_hash); any material instability is reported, not reconciled.

structural_credit_quality.note: Deterministic Layer-2 checks only; a valid citation id is not substantive proof and this does not assess live model semantic quality.
